title: Insert Slide Snapshots (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Insert Slide Snapshots applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Insert Slide Snapshots (BtnSlidePaste) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Snapshot grid layout is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The grid starts from the default snapshot size and shrinks the height by 5% per iteration (preserving the width/height ratio) until the rows fit the available area, bounded by 200 iterations and the ~0.5cm safety minimum (the historical loop stops after the shrink that crosses the floor, so the final height sits just below it); the column count is recomputed from the final size with a floor of one column.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
